_comment: Keyword rules used by scripts/npshistory_audit.py to classify NPSHistory.com document titles (and MPH narrative text) into document categories and sensitive-history themes. Patterns are case-insensitive Python regexes applied to 'title | citation | group header'. Text matching 'not' is blanked out before 'any' is tested (so 'Stonewall Jackson' never counts as LGBTQ). Tune here, not in code.
